responsibilities.purpose: Defines legal epistemic operation shapes and typed operands.
Proposes candidate CETA instructions only.
Evaluates preconditions, invariants, scope, authority and proof obligations.
Owns committed immutable transition history.
Derives current epistemic state exclusively from committed transition history.
Admits immutable evidence identities and provenance bindings.
Owns declared identities, verification state and supersession lineage.
Owns authority grants, revocation, permit state and consumed-nonce history.
Executes exact permitted external effects and nothing else.
Independently verifies resulting external reality; cannot execute the effect it verifies.
Provides derived graph/index projections over registered state; never canonical truth.
Compiles language, sensor and tool input into candidate structured observations.
Serializes registered state and communicative intent into language without mutating epistemic state.
Searches for missing evidence, contradictions, undercutters, stale scope and counterexamples.
Searches neighboring candidate transitions after denial or uncertainty; has no commit authority.
Produces threat observations/evidence; does not own constitutional verdicts.
Maps exact permitted effects to concrete tools/devices under the effect gateway.
Builds CETA worlds, trains proposal policy, evaluates executable transition behavior and governs checkpoint candidacy.
Maintains executable models and proof obligations for architecture invariants.
Owns UI/voice/local product surfaces without epistemic or execution authority.
